url.description: An http or https URL with a host and no credentials: a password in a URL is a secret in the file, and a secret is named, never carried.

description: The configuration of `access-roster controller slack`: the controller that makes each Slack workspace's user groups match the policy's slack table. Secrets are never in this file: a field ending in ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret, and a field ending in ...File holds a path. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

audit.description: The audit installation the controller records to, as its own workload. Unset only logs what it did.

consoleURL.description: The console's API, which answers who holds a group.

credentialsDir.description: One file per connected workspace: the app's credentials and its bot token.

enabledWorkspaces.description: The workspaces the controller changes, by the policy's key. Each must be one the policy declares.

policyDir.description: The directory the policy is mounted at: the bindings are the policy's slack table.

release.description: The name the installation's objects carry. It must be the release's full name: the controller reads the report and the records the service writes under it.

tokenFile.description: This pod's projected ServiceAccount token, presented to the console and read afresh on every call.

title: access-roster controller slack
